nodes.label: Webhook Processing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Webhook is ingested synchronously (returns 200 immediately) but processed asynchronously via asynq to meet Xendit's fast-response requirement while safely handling heavy DB operations. Two SELECT FOR UPDATE locks prevent duplicate worker processing and concurrent webhook races on the same invoice.

nodes.label: Decorator Cache Pattern
nodes.rationale: NewCachedAggregator wraps the HTTP client with in-memory cache, making the cache layer transparent to the service layer. Used in shipping and region modules.

nodes.label: Payment Transaction State Machine
nodes.rationale: Terminal states (expired, failed, refunded, voided) accept no further transitions. ErrAlreadyInState is idempotent (treat as no-op). ErrInvalidStatusTransition means a bug. State machine enforces business rules at domain layer, independent of DB.

nodes.label: Double-Entry Ledger
nodes.rationale: Append-only, immutable ledger. Every financial event creates a balanced journal (sum of debits = sum of credits). LedgerJournal.Validate() panics before DB write on imbalance. reference_id unique constraint provides idempotency via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.

nodes.label: XenPlatform Sub-Account Routing (for-user-id)
nodes.rationale: The platform's main API key is used for all calls but individual operations are scoped to a merchant's sub-account via for-user-id header. Transfer intentionally omits this header as it is a platform-level operation routing funds between main and sub-account.

nodes.label: Webhook Replay & Retry Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Three-layer retry: asynq automatic exponential backoff (5 attempts), job-based retry every 10min for failed events, and manual force-replay API. Replay is always safe because SELECT FOR UPDATE + state machine + ledger idempotency prevent double-application.

nodes.label: Security Design
nodes.rationale: Xendit uses static shared token validated with hmac.Equal for constant-time comparison (prevents timing side-channel). Signature failures return 200 silently to avoid leaking info to attacker. Tenant isolation via TenantID check returns ErrNotFound (not 403) to avoid leaking existence of cross-tenant resources.

nodes.label: SELECT FOR UPDATE Locking Pattern
nodes.rationale: Two locks acquired in webhook processing: (1) webhook event row lock prevents duplicate workers on same event; (2) transaction row lock prevents concurrent webhooks racing on same invoice. Both held in single READ COMMITTED transaction.

nodes.label: Idempotency Pattern
nodes.rationale: Idempotency enforced at multiple layers: domain ErrAlreadyInState, ledger reference_id UNIQUE index with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, payment_idempotency_keys table for API dedup, and webhook provider_event_id ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING at ingest. Reference ID format: txn:{transaction_id}:{event}:{account}.
